protocols.name: Golden Gate Assembly: Bacterial Threat NOT Inverter
protocols.opentrons_python_script:
# Opentrons OT-2 Protocol — Golden Gate Assembly for Bacterial Threat NOT Inverter (SYN-CIRC-001)
# Auto-generated by TRM Swarm OS v19 Sovereign Wet-Lab Robotics Driver
from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "Golden Gate Assembly — Bacterial Threat NOT Inverter",
    "author": "TRM Swarm Council / Archi & Devo",
    "description": "Automated BsaI-HFv2 / T4 Ligase assembly of SYN-CIRC-001 plasmid parts",
    "apiLevel": "2.14"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Deck configuration
    tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack])
    plate_parts = protocol.load_labware("corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat", 2)
    plate_dest = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 3)
    temp_mod = protocol.load_module("temperature module gen2", 4)
    temp_plate = temp_mod.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr")

    # Step 1: Pre-chill thermal module to 4°C
    temp_mod.set_temperature(4)

    # Step 2: Master Mix Distribution (T4 Buffer + BsaI + T4 Ligase: 10 uL per reaction)
    protocol.comment("Distributing Golden Gate Master Mix to reaction wells...")
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    for well_idx in range(4):
        p20.aspirate(10, plate_parts["A1"])
        p20.dispense(10, temp_plate.wells()[well_idx])
    p20.drop_tip()

    # Step 3: Part Transfer (2 uL per genetic part)
    part_wells = ["B1", "B2", "B3", "B4"] # Promoter, RBS, CDS, Terminator
    for idx, pw in enumerate(part_wells):
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(2, plate_parts[pw])
        p20.dispense(2, temp_plate.wells()[0])
        p20.mix(3, 10, temp_plate.wells()[0])
        p20.drop_tip()

    protocol.comment("Assembly complete. Transfer to thermocycler for 37°C/16°C cycling.")

parameters.reaction_chemistry: Golden Gate Type IIS BsaI Assembly

protocols.name: CLSI Broth Microdilution MIC: TRM-AMP-1123 vs Pseudomonas aeruginosa ATCC 27853
protocols.opentrons_python_script:
# Opentrons OT-2 Protocol — Microdilution MIC Assay for TRM-AMP-1123
# Target: Pseudomonas aeruginosa ATCC 27853 | Peptide: RACLKACWKWKITVTWKAKAK
from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "CLSI Broth Microdilution MIC — TRM-AMP-1123",
    "author": "TRM Swarm Council / Wet-Lab Driver",
    "description": "2-fold serial dilution (64 to 0.0625 ug/mL) in Mueller-Hinton II broth",
    "apiLevel": "2.14"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    tiprack_300 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    m300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_multi_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack_300])
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    plate_assay = protocol.load_labware("corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat", 3)

    # 1. Fill Columns 2-12 with 50 uL CAMHB broth
    protocol.comment("Dispensing 50 uL cation-adjusted Mueller-Hinton broth across assay plate...")
    m300.pick_up_tip()
    for col in range(1, 12):
        m300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
        m300.dispense(50, plate_assay.columns()[col][0])
    m300.drop_tip()

    # 2. Add 100 uL of 128 ug/mL stock AMP to Column 1
    m300.pick_up_tip()
    m300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A2"]) # Stock AMP reservoir
    m300.dispense(100, plate_assay.columns()[0][0])

    # 3. 2-Fold Serial Dilution across Columns 1 to 10
    protocol.comment("Performing 2-fold serial dilutions Column 1 through 10...")
    for col in range(0, 9):
        m300.aspirate(50, plate_assay.columns()[col][0])
        m300.dispense(50, plate_assay.columns()[col + 1][0])
        m300.mix(3, 40, plate_assay.columns()[col + 1][0])
    
    # Discard 50 uL from Column 10 to keep 50 uL constant
    m300.aspirate(50, plate_assay.columns()[9][0])
    m300.drop_tip()

    # 4. Inoculate with 50 uL bacterial culture (5e5 CFU/mL final in cols 1-11)
    protocol.comment("Inoculating columns 1-11 with standard McFarland bacterial suspension...")
    m300.pick_up_tip()
    for col in range(0, 11):
        m300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A3"])
        m300.dispense(50, plate_assay.columns()[col][0])
        m300.mix(2, 50, plate_assay.columns()[col][0])
    m300.drop_tip()

    protocol.comment("Assay plate setup complete. Ready for 18h incubation at 37°C in BioTek Cytation 5.")

protocols.name: Small-Scale Bioconjugation: ADC-HER2-012 (DM1 (Maytansinoid), DAR 8)
protocols.opentrons_python_script:
# Opentrons OT-2 Protocol — Small-Scale ADC Conjugation for ADC-HER2-012
# Target: HER2 | Linker: GGFG-Peptide | Payload: DM1 (Maytansinoid) | Target DAR: 8
from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "Antibody-Drug Conjugation & Desalting — ADC-HER2-012",
    "author": "TRM Swarm Council / Wet-Lab Driver",
    "description": "Cysteine interchain reduction (TCEP) followed by maleimide alkylation and buffer exchange",
    "apiLevel": "2.14"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    tiprack_200 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack_200])
    temp_mod = protocol.load_module("temperature module gen2", 3)
    reaction_plate = temp_mod.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr")
    reagent_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_generic_2ml_screwcap", 2)

    # 1. Temperature control: 22°C reduction
    temp_mod.set_temperature(22)

    # 2. Antibody + TCEP Partial Reduction (Equimolar TCEP for DAR 8)
    protocol.comment("Adding TCEP reducing agent to mAb solution...")
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(15, reagent_rack["A1"]) # TCEP stock (10 mM)
    p300.dispense(15, reaction_plate["A1"])
    p300.mix(4, 50, reaction_plate["A1"])
    p300.drop_tip()

    protocol.delay(minutes=90) # Reduction incubation

    # 3. Addition of Maleimide-Linker-Payload (GGFG-Peptide -> DM1 (Maytansinoid))
    protocol.comment("Adding DM1 (Maytansinoid) linker-toxin conjugate (1.5x molar excess per thiol)...")
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(25, reagent_rack["B1"]) # Drug-linker stock (DMSO)
    p300.dispense(25, reaction_plate["A1"])
    p300.mix(5, 60, reaction_plate["A1"])
    p300.drop_tip()

    temp_mod.set_temperature(4)
    protocol.delay(minutes=60) # Alkylation conjugation at 4°C

    # 4. Quench with N-acetylcysteine
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(10, reagent_rack["C1"]) # NAC quench
    p300.dispense(10, reaction_plate["A1"])
    p300.drop_tip()

    protocol.comment("Conjugation quenched. Ready for PD-10 desalting spin column purification.")
